content: Batch job resilience: process per-item (per-ticker) with try/except isolating failures so one bad item doesn't kill the run; use exponential backoff + jitter for transient errors (rate limits/network); idempotency via natural key (ticker+date) with upsert semantics so re-running a job is safe; log per-item outcome (success/fail/reason) plus a run-level summary row for observability.
